messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — planning to flip the prioritizer_v2 feature flag for EU prod tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. I'm deploying with @Priya. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15/30/45m observation windows. Safe default stays v1; kill switch ready. Who can OOO-watch?

Priya: I can pair for the deploy. quick checklist please and rollback steps.

Sam: I can be on-call during the first 60m and watch the dashboards. Pager contact is on my profile. :thumbsup:

Luca: Do we need any config flips for prefetch or per-tenant batching for v2? If so we should include them in the runbook.

Jordan: Good q — prioritizer_v2 reads the same cache keys; no DB schema changes. We do want prefetch disabled for the canary tenants to avoid caching masking regressions. I'll add that to runbook.

ops-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-18 09:00-10:30 UTC — channel reserved: #eng-runtime — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prioritizer-v2

Jordan: Smoke checklist (short):
- Confirm feature flag set for 5% via feature service
- Run quick synthetic: 200 reqs across 10 tenants (low-QPS)
- Verify /health and /metrics stable for 5m
- Check p99 latency and error rate on dashboards
- Validate fallback to v1 for errors

Commands for quick actions (copy-paste):
```bash
# set 5% canary in EU only
fflip set prioritizer_v2 true --percent=5 --region=eu --env=prod
# rollback to v1 globally
fflip set prioritizer_v2 false --env=prod
# check flag status
fflip status prioritizer_v2 --env=prod --region=eu
```

Jordan: Runbook kill criteria (we will rollback immediately if any of these are hit):
- error rate delta >= 0.5% absolute increase vs baseline
- p99 latency >= 2x baseline for >5 minutes
- any tenant sees >= 5% traffic dropped or 502 spikes

Priya: LGTM. Can we make the first canary 10 minutes instead of 15? less chance of hitting noise windows.

Jordan: Fine with 10m for first step, keep 30m for 25% stage. I'll update the timeline.

Sam: I'll open a temporary dashboard panel that shows p99, errors, and tail QPS by tenant and post the link here when ready.

Luca: I'll pre-create the list of canary tenant IDs (5 tenants) and share the CSV so you can pin them to the flag scope.

Jordan: Perfect. Final rollout steps I'll post in-channel right before flip. I'll also announce when we move to 25% and when full. If anything, run the global rollback command above and ping @Sam and @Priya.

Priya: Thanks — I'll be ready at 08:50 UTC for greenroom checks. :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll monitor and call for rollback if thresholds hit. If no issues, expect full flip by ~10:15 UTC.

Jordan: Thanks team — leaving the timeline in the runbook and will tag you when I start.
